entries.name: The Premium Finance Gap Calculator
entries.problem: Losing policy renewals because clients cannot afford the 20-30% premium down payment. 1, 2
entries.core_logic: Calculates (Total Premium * Down Payment %) - Available Cash to find the exact financing gap. 1

entries.name: The Urgent Tax Advance Estimator
entries.problem: Clients owe IRS, risk penalties, and lack the liquid cash to pay. 3, 4
entries.core_logic: Advance = Avg Rev * 0.5 to 1.5; Penalty Savings = Est. Tax * 0.005 * Months Past Due. 3

entries.name: The Gig Income Funding Predictor ("Giggle Finance")
entries.problem: Need instant funding predictions based on app revenue without hard credit pulls. 5, 6
entries.core_logic: Avg Weekly Earnings * 4, modified by a seniority factor (e.g., *1.2 for 2+ years). 5
entries.output_artifact: Back on the Road Funding Score 5

entries.name: The NECA Material Money Quoter
entries.problem: Winning a contract but lacking the upfront cash flow to buy materials before the first draw. 7, 8
entries.core_logic: Advance = Estimated Material Cost (capped at 25% of total job value or $50k). 7

entries.name: The "Turndown Retrieval" Script Generator
entries.problem: Bank officers are throwing away rejected leads and losing out on commissions. 9, 10
entries.core_logic: Inserts agent and bank branch names into a dynamic "50/50 commission split" pitch script. 9

entries.name: The Blue Collar Banker Lead Qualifier
entries.problem: Agents wasting time pitching non-fundable leads. 11
entries.core_logic: Deducts points from 100% for each missed underwriting minimum (Revenue, FICO, Time in Business). 11

entries.name: The Daily Commission Projection Dashboard
entries.problem: Need immediate, motivational calculations of daily earning potential. 12
entries.core_logic: Target Goal / Avg Commission = Deals Needed; Deals * 5 = Required Weekly Leads. 12

entries.name: The Auto-Repair Emergency Advance Tool
entries.problem: Car breaks down, and no cash for repairs means no ability to earn income. 13, 14
entries.core_logic: Funds up to 100% of the repair estimate, capped at $5,000 based on ride history. 13

entries.name: The Merchant Cash Advance (MCA) Repayment Estimator
entries.problem: Uncertainty about how daily MCA deductions will impact operating cash flow. 15
entries.core_logic: Total Repayment = Advance * Factor Rate; Daily Payment = Total Repayment / 90. 15

entries.name: The Competitor "Meet or Beat" Submitter
entries.problem: Skepticism about rates and predatory terms from other lenders. 16, 17
entries.core_logic: Captures competitor offer and verifies qualification for the $500 "Beat It" guarantee. 16

entries.name: The Referral Commission Payout Estimator
entries.problem: Affiliates want transparent expectations on exact commission payouts. 18
entries.core_logic: Client Funding Amount * Base Rate (Adjusted by New/Bronze/Silver tier). 18

entries.name: The Buy-Here-Pay-Here Down Payment Bridge
entries.problem: Customer is short on a vehicle down payment, killing the car sale. 19
entries.core_logic: Vehicle Down Payment Required - Customer Cash Available (Capped at $1,500). 19

entries.name: The Trade Association Profit-Split Calculator
entries.problem: Associations need non-dues revenue streams. 20, 21
entries.core_logic: Members * 5% Funding Rate * Avg Amount * 1% Override = Annual Revenue. 20

entries.name: The Credit Score vs. Cash Flow Analyzer
entries.problem: Feeling penalized by traditional banks for low FICO scores despite strong revenue. 22
entries.core_logic: Compares FICO (<600 = Bank Fail) against Monthly Deposits (>$5k = Breezy Pass). 22

entries.name: The Cold Lead Monetization Calculator
entries.problem: Throwing away rejected lease applications instead of monetizing them. 23
entries.core_logic: Rejected Leads * 15% Conversion * Avg Amount * 3% Comm * Split. 23

entries.name: The Payroll Bridge Funding Quoter
entries.problem: Client Net-30 payments are delayed, and Friday payroll must be met. 24
entries.core_logic: Recommends an advance equal to Total Weekly Payroll * 2 (up to $100k). 24

entries.name: The Trucker Repair-to-Revenue Tracker
entries.problem: Expensive truck repairs halt cash flow, causing panic. 25
entries.core_logic: Calculates Days to Recover = Repair Cost / (Avg Weekly Revenue / 7). 25

entries.name: The Passive Income Network Builder
entries.problem: Needs to see the exponential power of recruiting sub-agents to build downlines. 26
entries.core_logic: (Recruits * 4) * Avg T1 Commission * 0.5% override = Tier 2/3 Est. 26

entries.name: The "Bank Firing" Risk Score
entries.problem: Risk of rejection due to tightening Tier-1 banking standards. 27
entries.core_logic: Deducts points from 100 for <$250k Rev or <700 FICO. Score <50 = 85% Rejection Risk. 27

entries.name: The Equipment Leasing Deposit Calculator
entries.problem: Customers cannot afford the initial large security deposit for equipment leases. 28
entries.core_logic: Advance = Required Lease Deposit/Payment (capped at $25,000). 28

entries.name: The Same-Day vs. 60-Day Cost Analyzer
entries.problem: Waiting 60 days for a cheap bank loan costs more in lost revenue than a fast, expensive loan. 29
entries.core_logic: Average Daily Revenue * Days Lost Waiting for Bank = Revenue Lost. 29

entries.name: The Tax Prep Fee Advance Solution
entries.problem: Clients need cash for their IRS tax bill and the preparer's fee. 30
entries.core_logic: Advances the Tax Preparation Fee (up to $2,500) directly to the preparer's account. 30

entries.name: The "Bad Credit, Good Business" Certifier
entries.problem: Psychological discouragement from prior rejections. 31
entries.core_logic: If Months of Positive Cash Flow > 6, it overrides FICO and outputs a "Pass". 31

entries.name: The Service Industry Tip-to-Revenue Translator
entries.problem: Need to quantify credit card tips to prove steady revenue capacity to underwriters. 32
entries.core_logic: Repayment Capacity = (Daily CC Tip Rev + Daily CC Sale Rev) * 0.15. 32

entries.name: The NECA Endorsement Value Illustrator
entries.problem: Skepticism regarding alternative lender trust. 33
entries.core_logic: Outputs a high trust factor based on national trade association (NECA) backing. 33

entries.name: The Competitor Rate-to-Factor Rate Translator
entries.problem: Confusion comparing traditional time-based APRs to fixed MCA Factor Rates. 34
entries.core_logic: Translates Factor Rate (e.g., 1.18) to "$1.18 paid for every $1.00 borrowed". 34

entries.name: Cash Flow Gap Bridge Calculator
entries.problem: Finding the minimum MCA needed to cover immediate payroll/invoice gaps in under 60 seconds. 35
entries.core_logic: Cash Flow Gap Amount * 1.25 (Factor Buffer) = Needed MCA. 35

entries.name: Fix-and-Flip ROI & Max Loan Estimator
entries.problem: Hard money deal analysis to find max loan amount and potential ROI. 36
entries.core_logic: Max Loan = ARV * 0.75 LTV (Aligns with Hard Money limits). 36

entries.name: Startup Funding Eligibility Quiz
entries.problem: Brand new businesses (0 months) need pre-qualification without business history. 37
entries.core_logic: If FICO > 700 & Tradelines >= 5 -> Green Light (Startup Loan). Else -> Credit Incubator. 37

entries.name: "Bank-Rejected" Second Look Finder
entries.problem: Identifying viable alternatives after a rigid traditional bank denial. 38
entries.core_logic: Maps bank rejection reasons (e.g., Tax Lien, Time in Biz) to GoKapital's lenient products. 38

entries.name: Real Estate Proof of Funds (POF) Generator
entries.problem: Need an instant Proof of Funds letter to submit aggressive real estate offers. 39
entries.core_logic: Generates a conditional pre-qualification up to 80% LTV of the input offer amount. 39

entries.name: SBA Denial Pivot Tool
entries.problem: Cannot wait the 1-3 months required for SBA 7(a) loan approval. 40

entries.output_artifact: IRS Payment Plan vs. Advance Comparison 47

entries.name: Material Cost Inflation Tracker
entries.problem: Material prices surged since the bid; need to cover the budget gap. 48

entries.name: "Meet or Beat" Rate Comparison Tool

entries.problem: Ordering physical goods before renewals process; high churn results in dead stock. 78

entries.core_logic: Move Cost / ((Current Fee - New Fee) * Monthly Vol) = Months to Break Even. 79

entries.name: The "Fee Nullifier" Cash Back Calculator
entries.problem: Objection to advance fees masking the offsetting value of 2% cash back cards. 82
entries.core_logic: Gross Fee (Advance * 2%) - Cash Back (Advance * Reinvest % * 2%) = Net Cost. 82

entries.name: TikTok Shop Viral Curse Predictor
entries.problem: TikTok holds funds for 15-30 days; viral sales cause stockouts and late dispatch suspensions. 83
entries.core_logic: Current Cash / (Units Sold * Supplier Cost). If < 1.0, triggers "Critical" suspension risk. 83

entries.name: Account Level Reserve Hostage Calculator
entries.problem: Visceral anger at earned money being held hostage in the abstract "Account Level Reserve". 84
entries.core_logic: Reserve Balance * Avg Net Profit Margin * 1 extra turn/mo = Missed Profit. 84

entries.core_logic: Out of Stock Units * (Days Since OOS * Avg Daily Unit Sales) = Missed Sales Revenue. 86

entries.name: The FBA Prep Center Payout Predictor

entries.core_logic: Compares Margin vs 2% Fee. If Margin > Fee, nets a win by allowing 14 extra days of sales. 89

entries.name: The Wholesale Distributor Payout Gap Closer
entries.problem: Distributors forced to buy less profitable items because their cash is constrained. 90
entries.core_logic: Total Purchase Volume * (Desired Stock Margin - Constrained Stock Margin) = Profit Gap. 90

entries.name: The Multi-Channel Expansion Forecaster
entries.problem: Missing revenue by not expanding to Walmart/Shopify due to lack of setup capital. 91
entries.core_logic: Amazon Monthly Rev * 12 * Assumed Lift % = Missed Annual Revenue from not expanding. 91

entries.name: The Seasonal Stock-Up Stress Reliever
entries.problem: Panic about not ordering enough holiday inventory fast enough due to lead times. 92
entries.core_logic: (Daily Sales * Peak Multiplier * Lead Time) - Current Stock mapped to a funding timeline. 92

entries.name: The Freight Forwarder Funding Guarantee
entries.problem: Forwarders facing massive payment risk on shipping/duties invoices from cash-poor sellers. 93
entries.core_logic: Assures forwarder that client cash is released 14-28 days faster, eliminating invoice risk. 93

entries.name: The Q4 Profit Erosion Forecaster
entries.problem: Taking high-interest emergency MCAs during peak season erodes all net profit. 94
entries.core_logic: Total Q4 Inventory Needed * Interest Rate of Alternative Loan = Avoided Interest Cost. 94

entries.name: The Customer Review Velocity Builder
entries.problem: Slow cash limits launch inventory, delaying customer reviews and organic ranking. 95
entries.core_logic: Days Saved * Avg Daily Sales * Review Conversion Rate = Extra Reviews Gained. 95

entries.name: The "Bezos Interest" Calculator
entries.problem: Visualizes the opportunity cost of Amazon holding seller funds for 14 days. 96
entries.core_logic: Payout * (ROI% / 100) * (26 periods / 12). Calculates profit generated if reinvested instantly. 97

entries.name: The Stockout "Bleed" Auditor
entries.problem: Quantifies the dollar damage of waiting for a wire transfer while out of stock. 98
entries.core_logic: (Daily Sales * Profit * Days) + a 1.5x penalty for lost BSR ranking recovery costs. 98

entries.name: The "Velocity Multiplier" Simulator
entries.problem: Need to see the exponential math of flipping inventory 4x a month instead of 1x. 99
entries.core_logic: Models compound capital growth over 90 days at 30-day (standard) vs 7-day (OnRamp) intervals. 99

entries.problem: Amazon ending FBA prep means 3PLs demand upfront cash, gridlocking supply chains. 101
entries.core_logic: Monthly Units * Prep Fee = Upfront Cash Requirement needed before Amazon pays out. 101

entries.name: The Wholesale "Deal Sniper" Analyzer
entries.problem: Staring at a limited-time 40% off clearance lot and needing a go/no-go funding decision. 102
entries.core_logic: If (Projected Profit - Advance Fee) / Deal Cost > 10%, outputs "SNIPE IT". 102

entries.name: The "Unbankable" Fundability Quiz
entries.problem: Rejected by DTC-brand-only lenders (like Wayflyer) because they sell arbitrage goods. 103
entries.core_logic: If Rev > $3k and Platform = Amazon, issues instant approval based on store data, not FICO. 103

entries.name: The "Deferred Transaction" Unlocker

entries.core_logic: Dashboard Balance * 0.80 = Instantly Unlockable Amount within 4 hours. 105

entries.name: The "Zombie Inventory" Detector
entries.problem: Aged inventory storage surcharges eating away at margins. 106
entries.core_logic: Compares long-term holding cost against liquidating and reinvesting via OnRamp. 106

entries.name: The "Payroll Panic" Countdown Timer
entries.problem: Waiting on Net-60 GC check while Friday payroll approaches, risking crew walk-off. 107, 108
entries.core_logic: Current Balance / (Payroll * 1.18 / 5) = Days to Zero. Alerts if < Payment Date. 108

entries.name: The "Bid Protector" Inflation Adjuster
entries.problem: Bidding jobs 3 months out while volatile material prices (copper/PVC) eat margins. 109
entries.core_logic: Material Cost * (Inflation Factor * Duration). Outputs a Risk Buffer to add to the bid. 109

entries.name: The "Net-90" Opportunity Cost Calculator
entries.problem: Thinking saving a 2% funding fee is better than getting cash early to bid new jobs. 110
entries.core_logic: Annualized Cost of Waiting = (Potential Jobs Missed * Avg Profit) / Invoice Amount. 110

entries.name: The "Repair vs. Replace" ROI Engine
entries.problem: Semi-truck engine blows; emotional decision between a $25k rebuild or an $80k new truck. 111
entries.core_logic: Calculates Cash Flow Difference between the Repair Path and Replace Path over 12 months. 111

entries.name: The "Spot Market" Breakeven Calculator
entries.problem: Spot rates drop, truckers unsure of minimum Rate Per Mile (RPM) to cover insurance/fuel. 112
entries.core_logic: Fixed CPM + Variable CPM + (Desired Profit / Miles) = Minimum Acceptable Target Rate. 112

entries.name: The "Deal Killer" Hard Money Analyzer
